name: Bolingbroke Technology Center
summary: Monroe County's planning board and County Commission unanimously rejected rezoning for the proposed Bolingbroke campus after large public turnout. Later litigation prevents treatment as a settled final outcome.
proposal_description: The application sought commercial rezoning for a large, multi-building technology campus on mostly undeveloped land near U.S. 41, Wadley Road, and I-475.
site_afterlife: The denial was followed by litigation reported against the county. Until the legal and parcel status are resolved, no stable post-decision economic comparison should be made.
evidence_note: Disposition verified, but litigation makes the treatment date and finality unsuitable for causal modeling.

timeline.title: Large campus rezoning reaches public hearings
timeline.summary: The proposal sought rezoning of rural residential land for a gigawatt-scale campus.

timeline.title: Planning and Zoning Board recommends denial
timeline.summary: The board voted 5–0 against the rezoning after public testimony and concerns about compatibility and noise.

timeline.title: County Commission unanimously denies rezoning
timeline.summary: The commission issued the final local denial of the reviewed rezoning proposal.

timeline.title: Property owners challenge the denial
timeline.summary: Reported litigation means the rejected status remains legally contested.
